moments.text: Black screen; the picture starts at 11.4 s.
Infrared view of light grey sky under heavy black redaction. A dark round object sits in a small box at the crosshair, held steady.
A broad dark diagonal band sweeps in from the left across the object; within half a second dark fragments and streaks scatter across the frame.
Dark specks and short streaks drift down through the view as grey haze passes; nothing remains in the crosshair.
Empty grey sky: the crosshair switches between solid and dashed, a small box roams and brightness changes; a few small light specks drift through.

notes: Dark side bars and a thin green line along the bottom are not cropped (crop None).
